# `mise vars ls`

- **Usage:** `mise vars ls [--no-header]`
- **Aliases:** `list`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/vars/ls.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/vars/ls.rs)

List the saved answers

Reads `$MISE_STATE_DIR/vars.toml`; no config is loaded.

## Flags
- **`--no-header`** — Do not print the table header
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
